description_en: Adds tags to one or more cloud phones
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic tag-resources --resource-type ALIYUN::ACP::INSTANCE --resource-id acp-123456ab0000 --tag Value=design Key=department --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. The value must be \`ALIYUN::ACP::INSTANCE\`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud phone IDs. The list can contain 1 to 50 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID 列表，即云手机 ID 列表。可包含 1~50 个
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot be an empty string. The key cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\` and cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can be an empty string. The value cannot start with \`acs:\` and cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. The list can contain 1 to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。可包含 1~20 个
parameters.name: tag
